searchText: Any recent recorded crypto webinars/workshops/socratics I can watch? Wondering what the latest buzz is. 🤔 Ooo, actually this will do https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uGeIDNEwHjs, found this in <#595711919378268160> Can't go wrong with EEG: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-vTX48dxTsY How long do we have for mining ETH? There are some speculations that PoW to PoS might happen late into 2023, is that true, if not, then when is the end of ETH mining? I heard today that in August 2021 ETH mining will become useless after the PoW to PoS merger. Antminer E9 is shipping out in July, and August seems to be the end of mining? Could someone explain, please? Unofficial estimate from random person on the internet: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/598292067260825641/841806358130851840 2023 is wildly pessimistic, that must be an old assumption people have not updated. the most optimistic takes I've seen are October 2021, the more conservative are for Q1 2022. you should prepare for mining to end in 6-9 months if you are currently mining where did you hear this, can i get a link and jump in? you have to remember that any miner that bitmain sells they've already been mining on for some time at that point they're just liquidating their inventory before the value of miners drops too much to make it worth selling because the merger is coming but no the merger is probably Q4 <@!420951281910284289> I heard it from someone I know, not sure where he got it from, but someone on <#688075293562503241> pointed to https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/1559-updates/https%3A%2F%2Fhackmd.io%2F%40timbeiko%2F1559-resources <@!129305432891195393> I never considered that, it's probable but it seems very unlikely they were known to do it with sha256 miners I believe it was discovered due to some miners outgassing and some of them not I think that's the play ...dogecoin is mined with asics
